categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Keysino Separation Technology Inc. primarily operates in industrial fluid special separation, focusing on membrane separation technology research and development. The company provides customized membrane separation technology application solutions including clean production technology design and implementation, membrane separation equipment integration, operational technical support, and after-sales services. Its main products are membrane separation system integrated devices and replacement parts and consumables for membrane-based clean production processes. Key industries served include bio-pharmaceuticals, chemical fiber, textile dyeing, petrochemical, coal chemical, new energy, pulp, and metallurgy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary membrane separation application technologies combined with deep understanding of various domestic and international membrane products. It integrates membrane separation technology with crystallization and biological treatment technologies to optimize industrial fluid processes, recover valuable substances, and achieve near-zero discharge. Production involves project-based customized design, process development, control system programming, and outsourced component manufacturing. The company emphasizes R&D-driven innovation with continuous investment in technology development and patent acquisition.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are industrial clients in sectors such as bio-pharmaceuticals, chemical fiber, textile printing and dyeing, petrochemical and coal chemical industries, new energy, pulp, and metallurgy. The company serves clients requiring industrial fluid process treatment and wastewater treatment solutions, focusing on improving resource recycling efficiency, reducing production costs, and minimizing pollutant emissions. It also targets markets with growing environmental regulation and demand for green production technologies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant domestic sales accounting for over 85% of revenue. It also has international operations, including a subsidiary in Singapore, and actively expands overseas markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, and Europe. The company participates in international industry exhibitions and leverages local advantages to deepen market penetration abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Keysino operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on integrating membrane separation technologies into industrial fluid processing systems. It procures membrane components and control systems from upstream suppliers and provides integrated equipment and technical services to downstream industrial customers. The company does not manufacture membranes but specializes in system integration and application solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to enhance membrane separation technology innovation and expand application scenarios across multiple industries. It focuses on developing green, low-carbon, and efficient industrial fluid separation solutions aligned with national environmental policies. Key R&D projects include resource recovery from industrial wastewater, zero discharge technologies, catalyst recovery, and biomass material utilization. The company also strengthens talent development and collaborates with academic institutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial fluid separation integrated equipment and related replacement parts and consumables. The company also earns income from equipment leasing, operational services including wastewater treatment and water reuse fees, and technical service fees. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales supported by technical consulting and customized solution development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Keysino is one of the few domestic companies capable of providing comprehensive membrane separation technology application solutions in the industrial fluid field. It holds a strong market position due to its proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and broad application experience across industries. The company differentiates itself by combining deep process knowledge with membrane technology expertise, unlike upstream membrane manufacturers or downstream industrial clients who lack such integration capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 124.6 million, a 19.11% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.58 million, down 43.06%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 724 million and equity of RMB 661 million. Despite short-term revenue decline due to macroeconomic fluctuations and client capacity control, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 11.61% of revenue. It has a stable financial foundation and ongoing contracts worth RMB 86 million to be recognized in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Keysino emphasizes its ability to provide customized, high-value industrial fluid separation solutions that optimize production processes, enhance resource recovery, and reduce environmental impact. Its competitive edge lies in integrating advanced membrane technologies with deep industry process understanding, enabling clients to achieve clean production, cost savings, and near-zero discharge. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive after-sales service system further differentiate it in the market.
